description: The ASHRAE Global Occupant Behavior Database gathers 34 field-measured datasets on how people occupy and operate buildings, contributed by 39 institutions in 15 countries and covering 10 Köppen-Geiger climate zones, as part of IEA EBC Annex 79. It covers commercial and residential buildings and records occupancy (presence and people counts), occupant interactions with lights, thermostats, fans, windows, doors, shades and other systems, and the indoor and outdoor environmental conditions around them. The 2022 Scientific Data paper describes the harmonisation of the datasets, and the final files were also deposited on figshare. Coverage: 34 studies in 15 countries across several building types. Access: a website to query and download chosen datasets or the whole database, plus the figshare deposit. Licence: described as publicly available; the paper is CC BY 4.0, and dataset terms should be checked on download. Caveats: studies differ in sampling interval, sensors and duration, and many cover single buildings, so pooled analyses need care. Simulation uses are fitting and testing occupant behaviour models, occupancy schedules and agent-based building energy simulation. Related records: the ASHRAE Global Thermal Comfort Database II and the Occupancy Simulator.
